verdict.rationale: There is no first-party bulk-action feature in the evidence. The closest support is `humanlayer automation run`, which runs one Cloud-visible session from a CI job, cron machine, or script, so batching many items means writing your own loop around it. Multi-repository workspace config lets a single task span several repos, which is only adjacent to bulk operations. Missing for 10: native bulk select or apply actions across many tasks or sessions, bulk task creation from multiple tickets or issues, a documented batch API, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
